name: Apart Mare
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apart Mare is a holiday apartment located in Sölden in the Ötztal region. The accommodation is situated in the heart of Sölden, just 300 meters from the base stations of the Giggijoch and Zentrum cable cars. The apartments feature a kitchenette, a seating area, and a balcony or terrace. A ski storage room and a drying area are available to all guests for free. Free Wi-Fi and parking are included in your stay. The location offers direct access to hiking and biking trails in the summer, as well as downhill skiing routes in the surrounding ski resorts in the winter.
